name: DeepEval
description: Open-source, pytest-style LLM evaluation framework aimed at application testing: metrics such as G-Eval, answer relevancy, faithfulness and tool-correctness are computed with LLM-as-a-judge or local NLP models. It also bundles implementations of several public benchmarks (MMLU, HellaSwag, BBH, DROP, TruthfulQA, HumanEval, GSM8K) that follow the original papers' prompting. Scores are self-run by the user; the company sells a hosted platform (Confident AI) around it.
notes: First PyPI release 0.2.0 on 2023-08-15 (repo created 2023-08-10). Benchmark list from deepeval.com/docs/benchmarks-introduction.
